blocks.text: High-Energy
Kids' Birthday Parties
In Springfield, MO
NINJA WARRIOR COURSES, LASER TAG, NERF BATTLES, AND MORE!
Kids Will Have a Blast, and You Can Relax

Springfield Warrior Sports is the ideal venue for a birthday party in Springfield, MO. With a variety of party options facilitated by our crew and a full hour of gym time, adults can relax knowing everything is taken care of while the kids have fun!

Parties here are extraordinary - not only do we promise that kids will love it, but we also make sure the birthday boy or girl has something special too; the week after their party, the birthday kid gets to come to a ninja class for free and their very own Ninja t-shirt!
This means more than just one day of fun - there can be lasting memories of their best birthday, making this party extra memorable.
Warrior Sports Takes the Stress Out of Your
Birthday Party Planning
At Springfield Warrior Sports, we want to take the stress out of your party planning - schedule your birthday party with us, and let us do the rest — including cleanup!

Each party lasts for a total of 1.5 hours. Included in the party is one hour of gym time, featuring open play and an obstacle course set up and facilitated by our Crew. Approximately 30 minutes can be used for cake, presents, and pizza! (optional).
The birthday child will receive a Springfield Warrior Sports T-shirt, and the week after their party, they get to try a ninja class for free.
Note: free customized party invitations are available upon request.

Cost: $179 for the first 11 kids and $10 for each additional participant (plus $40 if you prefer to rent the gym for a private party). The parents of the birthday child are free if they would like to try the obstacles as well! A $40 deposit is required at the time of booking and will be taken off the full amount on the day of the party. All other guests (siblings, other parents, etc.) who wish to play in the gym can simply pay the discounted group rate for open gym during the party time.
* All participants will need to sign a waiver before playing in the gym. This can be done by a parent in the gym upon arrival, or it may be filled out online prior to the party.

** To reserve your birthday party time slot, a $40 deposit is required at booking and covers the first 11 kids. The rest of the $179, additional participants or optional add-ons will be settled on the day of the party. BOOK NOW! You can begin the birthday party scheduling process on our website by clicking here, or call us today at (417) 894-7319 to reserve your birthday party spot at Warrior Sports! Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy: To help us staff and prepare properly, any cancellations or reschedules made starting the weekend immediately before your party date and at any point thereafter will incur a $60 fee.
More Birthday Party Options at Springfield Warrior Sports
Want to feed the birthday party or have birthday battles instead of an obstacle course race?
We can help you with that!
PIZZA BIRTHDAY PARTY WITH NO CLEAN UP!

Our birthday party pizza package includes plates, napkins, utensils, and pizza from Godfather's Pizza. Two pizzas will be ordered for a party of 10 kids, but we will adjust and order more if there are more kids attending. The pizza party add-on is $50, and extra pizzas can be requested for family members or adults for $12 each.
Have Battles in Our Obstacle Course Gym
Nerf Battle Parties

Our crew will set up and facilitate a Nerf Battle for your party rather than an obstacle course. Nerf parties must be scheduled during a private party time slot. Nerf Battle Parties are an additional $70, and the price includes a private party fee of ($40) and a staff/equipment fee of ($30).
LASER TAG PARTIES

The Springfield Warrior Sports team will set your birthday party up for a super fun laser tag battle with our high-end laser tag guns. Laser tag parties must be scheduled during a private party time slot. Laser Tag Parties are an additional $90, and the investment includes a private party fee of ($40) and a staff/equipment fee of ($50).
Create Amazing
Memories

Create unforgettable memories with your kids and their friends in an uber-kid-friendly atmosphere. Your child will have the time of their life playing in our obstacle course gym while you sit back and relax without having to stress out about setting up or cleaning up afterward.
Plus, our cooler of Gatorade keeps everyone well-hydrated during all that physical activity!
Shoot us a message here with your desired birthday party dates, or call (417) 894-7319 to book your birthday experience at Springfield Warrior Sports!

Parkour Benefits
Improve Physical Fitness:

Parkour can help to improve overall physical fitness and develop a greater strength, speed, stamina and balance. The movements involve a variety of exercises that work out several muscles at once, allowing for a complete body workout.
Builds Self-Confidence:

By learning how to overcome obstacles and accomplish difficult tasks such as running, jumping and climbing, Parkour can help build self-confidence as students become more competent in their abilities. As they learn to move freely with the environment around them, they become more confident in their own abilities to adapt and succeed in new situations.
Mental Stimulation:

Parkour offers an enjoyable and mentally stimulating activity that allows students to practice coordination skills while having fun at the same time. It also encourages problem solving skills as students have to find creative ways of navigating through different obstacle courses and scenarios.
Stress Relief:

Parkour is a great way to reduce stress levels by letting off some steam while using physical activity as an outlet for negative emotions. The mental clarity that comes from focusing on the task at hand helps clear the mind of any distractions or worries that may be plaguing it, allowing for renewed focus and energy afterwards.
Community:

Participants in Parkour can gain access to a strong supportive community of like-minded individuals who are all striving for personal growth through physical activity with each other's support and encouragement.

Obstacle Course Racing Classes:
A Unique Workout Experience

OCR workouts and fitness classes are designed to help you conquer obstacles both mentally and physically, while having fun at the same time! Let’s explore further why obstacle course racing is such an effective form of exercise.
WHAT IS OCR FITNESS?

OCR fitness classes take the best of the traditional gym experience and add an extra layer of excitement. By incorporating a variety of obstacles into each class, participants are able to get creative with their workouts and challenge themselves in ways they wouldn’t be able to in a regular gym setting. This helps keep motivation levels high and provides an outlet for those looking for something different than the typical exercise bike or treadmill routine.
OCR Fitness Class
Benefits

The benefits of OCR fitness classes extend far beyond just physical exercise; it also provides many mental health benefits as well. The unique challenges presented by each obstacle help boost confidence levels by teaching participants how to problem-solve on their feet and push their limits further than they thought possible.

Additionally, the group atmosphere also encourages camaraderie among participants, which can help build strong connections between members who may not have otherwise interacted with one another in a regular gym setting.
Short-Term Goals And
Long-Term Gains

OCR training has been proven to improve overall physical health as well as strength, agility, balance, coordination, endurance, and speed - all essential components needed for any type of longevity goal, athletic activity, or sport.

The combination of low-impact exercises along with more intense activities helps train the body in ways that cannot be replicated in other forms of exercise, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking to switch up their workout routine or take their athletic performance up a notch.
Improved Confidence Levels
And Mental Health

Our Obstacle Course Racing (OCR) workouts and fitness classes in Springfield, MO provide a unique way to get fit while also having fun! Not only do you get the physical benefits from this type of workout, but you also receive numerous mental health benefits such as improved confidence levels and connection building with other members within the group atmosphere that these classes offer.
Additionally, many enjoy pairing these fitness classes with our Parkour class options adding even more unique workout sessions each week.
So if you’re ready for a new challenge, sign up for our OCR Fitness Classes today! You won't regret it!

pages.title: About Springfield Warrior Sport's Community and Vision
pages.description: Springfield Warrior Sports was founded with a desire to serve our community. Here's our story about our efforts to improve Springfield, MO.
pages.h1: Springfield Warrior Sports Community
pages.heroAlt: SPRINGFIELD WARRIOR SPORTS COMMUNITY

blocks.text: Springfield Warrior Sports was founded with a love for, and desire to serve our community. Community unites us, and allows us to be a part of something greater than ourselves. It provides an opportunity to connect with people and other local businesses, who when we all work together, make this the awesome community so many of us call home. We strive to provide a safe place and outlet - for youth, and adults, who are looking for a fun and different workout and the freedom to MOVE as they set and achieve their goals on their quest for a healthy lifestyle. We also love going out into the community to serve outside of our walls, through adopt-a-highway, partnering with local events and speaking at school assemblies. We are most certainly, Stronger Together!
CURIOUS ABOUT THE COLORS OF OUR GYM?

Our inspiration is the new Springfield flag which has nods to our culture and history |we’ll let you look that up| but the main goal of the developers was to “come up with an authentic icon that people connected with and could use to express their pride living in Springfield” - John McQueary
Community Adopt-A-Highway Clean up Days

Springfield Warrior Sports is proud to help keep a little piece of our community, cleaner! We have adopted the highway on South Campbell, between Weaver and Plainview, near the gym. We love doing our part, and think it’s awesome that the Warrior Sports Crew, members, and friends can come together and be involved. It’s also a good time!! Thanks to Thrivent Financial for sponsoring the event and to Mid-Missouri Bank for allowing us to meet in your community room. We are truly, Stronger Together!
Community Partnerships
BIG BROTHERS BIG SISTERS OF THE OZARKS

"A mentor empowers a person to see a possible future and believe it can be obtained” Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Ozarks makes impactful, monitored matches between adult volunteers (“Bigs”) and children (“Littles”), ages 6 through 14. Through this program, positive relationships are developed that have a direct and lasting effect on the lives of young people in our community! At Springfield Warrior Sports we applaud and want to support their mission. "Bigs" when you drop in for open gym, your "Little" gets in free! Come have fun, or maybe challenge each other to something new! Together, we are STRONGER..... one Obstacle at at Time!
SUPPLEMENT SUPERSTORE

We want to give a huge shout out to Supplement Superstore! S2 has been a huge supporter of Springfield Warrior Sports and our athletes over the years, and these guys... are doing it right! They have solid fitness nutrition products and considerately share expert advice after listening to your specific goals. They can offer personal training, nutrition coaching and meal plans - and they won't leave you hanging... you can expect that they will check in on your progress, as they truly want you to succeed! Go check them out now, all ages and athletic backgrounds.
Perseverance:
PERSISTENCE IN DOING SOMETHING DESPITE DIFFICULTY OR DELAY IN ACHIEVING SUCCESS.

The very nature of this sport involves setting goals for yourself, hard work and determination (perseverance), and supportive friends (community)! At Springfield Warrior Sports we love the opportunity to share our experiences, failures and successes, through the sport and training on and off the course with the youngest of athletes and individuals. We are available to speak, demonstrate, and provide interactive team building for your next school assembly, field day, or youth activity. Each of us are stronger, one Obstacle at a time!

In 2016 we had the unique opportunity to work with James River Church planning their Ninja Warrior course that was a part of their Stronger Men’s Conference. Under Jason Huewe’s direction, Springfield Warrior Sports assisted with design and build of the course, running the West Campus competition, and securing athletes from across the country. We also held a local competition at the gym where the top 5 athletes secured their spot to compete on the course alongside the American Ninja Warriors who attended for their chance to win $5000! What a night, so much fun being a part of this collaboration and display of camaraderie with such inspiring individuals… each modeling that we are Stronger, one Obstacle at a time!
COMMUNITY MURPH
Springfield Warrior Sports looks forward each year to bringing a team and participating in the local annual Community Murph!

Every year on Memorial Day, the Southwest Missouri community comes together to honor our fallen heroes. Funds are raised for local charities so that they can continue to provide support for these families. We are so encouraged to be a part of this event and have watched it continue to grow with this communities engagement - Nationwide, this event has raised millions of dollars for charities including the LT. Michael P. Murphy Memorial Scholarship Foundation (SEAL). It’s a grueling challenge, that brings people together to pay tribute and the tradition helps push us, humble us both mentally and physically and dedicate a bit of pain and sweat to honor a man who gave everything he had. We are… Stronger, together.

pages.title: Springfield Warrior Sports Coaches | Meet Our Training Team
pages.description: Meet the experienced coaches at Springfield Warrior Sports. Our team of mentors and competitors helps athletes grow in confidence, strength, and skill.
pages.h1: Meet the Springfield Warrior Sports Team
pages.heroAlt: MEET THE SPRINGFIELD WARRIOR SPORTS TEAM

blocks.text: At Springfield Warrior Sports, our coaches are more than instructors.
They’re mentors, competitors, and people who genuinely care about helping others grow on the course and in life.
Get to know the coaches who make this community what it is.
Jonny
Co-Owner | Adult OCR Coach | Intermediate Coach
Hey there! I’m Jonny.
I’ve been part of Springfield Warrior Sports since the very beginning back in 2015, and today I’m a co-owner alongside my beautiful wife, Sarah.
Almost nothing in the whole world brings me more joy than living vicariously through the achievements and joy of the kids at the gym. Some of my best friends are the kids we teach in our classes.
My ninja journey includes winning the 2017 UNAA National Championship, placing 3rd at the 2018 NNL World Championships,
competing on Season 11 of American Ninja Warrior, and earning 6th place at the 2024 WNL World Championships.
At the gym, I primarily teach the Intermediate classes, and the Adult O.C.R. class on Thursdays.
Outside the gym, I love my wife, Nintendo, weight-lifting, ninja, of course, Star Wars, Lord of the Rings, BeyBlade, Bakugan, Dragon Ball, Naruto, reading (when I have time),
basically anything that reminds me of my childhood, but above all, I love God.
I definitely have the heart and soul of my 8-year old self, and I pray I’m always able to keep that alive in me.
I love meeting new people and growing our community. I’d love to meet you and welcome you into the Warrior Sports family.
Sarah
Co-Owner | Adult OCR Coach | Preschool Coach | Women’s Fitness Trainer
Hey guys! I’m Sarah.
I’m a co-owner of Springfield Warrior Sports alongside my amazing husband, Jonny.
I first entered the Warrior Sports world when we started dating in 2019,
and I had no idea at that time that this sport and the people who come with it would mean so much to me.
I teach preschool classes and the Adult O.C.R. Class on Thursdays, and love every minute of connecting with our members.
I am also a personal trainer for women and dedicate a few days each week to designing workouts and helping women feel confident in the bodies God has given them.

Outside the gym, I enjoy reading, crafts, being outdoors, hammocking/hiking/running, working out, and hanging out with my family. I am the second oldest (oldest girl) of 6 kids, and have always had a motherly, take-charge personality.
I’m excited to meet you. Come hang out with the fam!
Lincoln
Beginner Ninja Coach | Birthday Party Host
Hello! I'm Lincoln.
I’ve been working at Springfield Warrior Sports for three years and have been training in ninja since 2018. I teach our beginner classes
and help out with birthday parties. I joined the team about a year and a half after starting at Ninja and have been competing since then.
I'm an active and sporty person, and I enjoy playing recreational volleyball in my free time. I enjoy video games, solving Rubik's cubes, and other random activities as well.
I am a very relationally based person, always wanting to make friends and hang out, which is why I love my job so much.
As a coach, I strive to be the best teacher I can be, creating a fun and engaging learning experience in our classes while also challenging my students to grow and improve.
Ellory
Advanced Team Head Coach | Preschool Coach | Birthday Party Host
I first got into ninja by watching American Ninja Warrior and building homemade obstacle courses with my siblings using pull-up bars, couch cushions, hallway walls…whatever we could find.
When my parents surprised us by signing us up at Springfield Warrior Sports, I quickly took to it and have loved it ever since.
After lots of classes and open gyms, I started improving more and more,
and I’ve now competed as an elite in the World Ninja League for two years, making it to Stage 3 at the World Championships both times
and finishing in the top 11 my second year.
I joined the staff here in May 2023, and since then, I’ve been teaching the Tuesday preschool class.
Recently, I became the head coach for the CSNA Team Class, which is our most advanced class for kids up to 18 years old.
I also work birthday parties, which are always a lot of fun!
I love working with the kids and helping them grow, and it really is such a joy for me to see them learning new things and watch their hard work pay off.
Outside of ninja, I like to try out all different kinds of sports, of which I love pickleball, football, and bowling, especially.
I also love playing instruments, learning about Christianity and growing in discipleship, and reading.
I really enjoy spending quality time with people I know and meeting new people I don't,
but I also love just spending time with myself, doing my own thing, for which I am very grateful.
Elle
Preschool Coach | Birthday Party Host
Hi! My name is Elle, and I’ve been working at Warrior Sports for the past four months.
I teach preschool classes and assist with running birthday parties.
I was introduced to the gym by family members who have competed here, and I have since become involved myself, attending adult workout classes,
which have helped improve my volleyball game.
I truly love my job. It's so rewarding to see the kids grow in their skills and overcome new challenges. The work environment is welcoming, supportive, and a lot of fun!
Connor
Advanced Team Assistant | Beginner Ninja Coach | Birthday Party Host
Hello, I’m Connor!
I’ve been part of the Springfield Warrior Sports team since early 2018
and started working at Warrior Sports in 2022. I was drawn to ninja for its creativity, problem-solving, strength, agility, and precision.
After starting in parkour classes, I was invited to join the CSNA team early on.
Over time, I’ve competed in small and large ninja competitions and pushed myself to grow both physically and mentally.
I’m a 2-time WNL Worlds finalist and a 1-time UNAA world finalist. I placed top 100 in the 2024 WNL Worlds competition.
In the 2024 UNAA worlds competition, I fractured my nose on the second-to-last obstacle and ended my run early.
Some of my greatest accomplishments outside of competing are being the shortest person to conquer the 18’ warped wall at 5’ 2”, and doing 40 pull-ups without dropping.

I also run Birthday Parties and currently teach the beginner Warrior classes and am a secondary coach to the advanced team classes. What I love most is helping kids build confidence and helping them push themselves mentally and physically.
Outside of ninja, I like to weight lift and train flips, and when I’m not training, you’ll probably find me playing chess, solving Rudbik’s cubes, and playing Minecraft. I also like cheese burgers.
Caleb
Beginner Ninja Coach | Preschool Coach | Birthday Party Host
Hey everyone! I’m Coach Caleb.

I’ve been part of the Warrior Sports team since May 31, 2025. I’ve always loved working out and staying active, and I wanted to try something a little different—ninja training was the perfect fit. It’s challenging, fun, and pushes you to move in new ways.
Here at W.S., I teach our Beginner Ninja classes and Preschool Ninja classes,
and I also help run birthday parties (they’re some of my favorite days on the job!).
Whether it’s someone’s first class or their tenth, I love seeing kids get stronger, more confident, and more excited every time they walk through the door.
Outside the gym, I’m into rock climbing, caving, and weight lifting—basically anything that keeps me moving and gets the adrenaline going.
When it’s time to eat, you’ll catch me loading up on shrimp and fried rice, steak, or sushi—top-tier meals in my book!
I’m all about helping kids have fun, get fit, and feel like ninjas. Can’t wait to train with you!
Ruby
All-Levels Ninja Coach | Private Training | Birthday Party Host
I’m Ruby Wilder, and I’ve been involved in Warrior Sports since I was five years old.
I competed from ages 8 to 11 and officially started working at Warriors Sports in 2022. I coach all classes from the preschool class up to the advanced team class, along with one-on-one training.
I also work birthday parties, logins, laser/nerf nights, and parents' night out.

Outside the gym, I’m an artist in all categories. I am a musician, play the harp and bass, and I sing professionally as well. I am also a babysitter, as well as an animal caretaker. I love Chinese and Mexican food, and my favorite color is purple!!!
Josiah
Birthday Party Host
My name is Josiah, and I’ve trained and competed in ninja for about eight years and have loved every second of it.
After placing top 100 in the world in the World Ninja League in 2024, I sadly had to take a big break from the sport and leave for College of the Ozarks,
where I am now studying graphic design.
On top of ninja, I have many interests and hobbies I pursue, including parkour, baseball, street art, and drawing, to name a few.
Here at Springfield Warrior Sports, I was the head coach of the beginner classes and worked all the summer camps before I left for college,
but now you will most commonly find me here on the weekends working birthday parties and training whenever I can.
Jacob
Lead Personal Trainer
Hi! I’m Jacob Winter.
I’ve been an employee of Springfield Warrior Sports since 2017, initially being drawn to the sport of NinjaWarrior.
I’ve competed in several regional and national-level competitions, and that nourished my passion for fitness and community.
I’ve worked in every capacity at Springfield Warrior Sports, including hosting birthdays, running Jr Ninja Warrior classes, and ensuring everyone is having fun!

My main job is to head up the personal training side of the gym, working with age ranges from 10-100, helping people achieve their fitness goals and engage with the community. Nothing brings me more joy!
Outside of the gym, I can be found performing at our local community theatre, watching cartoons and playing video games, and hanging out with my friends!
Grace
Beginner Ninja Coach | Birthday Party Host
Hi, I’m Grace.
I’ve been training at Warrior Sports since I was 8 years old and began working there at 15. On weekends, I host birthday parties and occasionally teach beginner classes.
I’ve been competing since 2018, traveling across the country for UNAA and WNL events. I’ve also competed at Worlds, earning multiple top-10 finishes in my division.
Outside of ninja, I play softball and run track for Reeds Spring High School.
YOU'VE MET THE TEAM. NOW TRAIN WITH THEM. You’ve met the coaches who make Springfield Warrior Sports what it is. Now, come be a part of it and experience it for yourself.

They offer 24-hour access, individualized coaching, online training, and a wide variety of programs to meet you where you are—and help you move forward with confidence.

Proximal isn’t just about fitness—it’s about never quitting, even when life hits hard. From functional fitness to endurance work, this gym runs deep on faith, hustle, and community.
You’ll find a welcoming crew, killer programming, and trainers who actually care if you show up tomorrow. Bonus: their onboarding session for new members sets you up for success from day one.

If you're after a fitness center in Springfield, MO with everything under one roof, Genesis is your spot. Lap pool? Check. Steam room? Check. Zumba, yoga, barre, and childcare? Double check.
Great for families or anyone who wants spa-day extras without sacrificing training options. Genesis blends upscale with usable—and keeps it accessible for every level.
